description: This file defines extension methods for configuring TLS security in Orleans-based network connections and exposes related security types and interfaces.

classes.name: TlsClientAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for client-side TLS authentication, including protocols and certificates.

classes.name: TlsOptions
classes.description: General TLS options, including certificate validation, modes, protocols, and event hooks.

classes.name: TlsServerAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for server-side TLS authentication including certificates and protocols.

methods.name: UseClientTls
methods.description: Extension method to configure client-side TLS on a connection builder.

methods.name: UseServerTls
methods.description: Extension method to configure server-side TLS on a connection builder.
